patch.summary: Adapt.io cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Adapt.io pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Adapt.io plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: contact data, prospecting, data enrichment · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Starter
lines.description: 7-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Basic
lines.description: 7-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Custom
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Adapt.io cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Adapt.io against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, lead scoring) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches
Side-by-side cost with UpLead on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: No native email sequencing — data/export first

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Daily contact caps on Free/Starter/Basic constrain volume

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Phone credits only unlock meaningfully on Basic+

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Reporting is basic usage vs enterprise SI analytics

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Adapt.io on identical constraints.
